findings.summary: The facade orchestration is not directly covered by the packet-named tests.
findings.consequence: A wiring regression in loadReaderSourceInfo, such as using the wrong runtime config value for static definitions or failing to pass the attribution resolver into buildReaderSourceInfo, could pass the current listed tests because they cover the constituent helpers and facade exports rather than this function's end-to-end composition.
findings.evidence: loadReaderSourceInfo is the only function that combines createServerLbApiClient(event), fetchWorkSourceInfo, loadCachedReaderSourceInfoStaticDefinitions(config.contentBase), and buildReaderSourceInfo. The packet-named facade test only asserts export identity, and reader-source-info.spec.ts exercises fetchWorkSourceInfo, static definition loading, projection, and attribution helpers separately; rg shows the sole runtime caller is server/api/reader/source-info/[author]/[title].get.ts.
findings.recommendation: Add a focused unit or route-level test that drives /api/reader/source-info or loadReaderSourceInfo with mocked upstream source-info, static definitions, and /authors/resolve behavior, asserting successful projection and 502 mapping for static/projection failures.
